IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging: runtime-high-error-rate in us-west-2 (severity=sev2) — multiple model warmup OOMs detected across autoscale group. Paging oncall now.
Alex: I’m on it. Seeing a spike in 5xx and GPU OOMs starting ~3487654200. Root logs show deserialization failures during model load for rwd-embed-7b.
Morgan: Confirmed. Metrics: model_warmup_failures up 420% over baseline, node flaps 3 instances in last 10m. ETA: currently investigation.
Sam: Pasted the most recent pod logs: ```
[2026-03-14T21:05:32Z] model_load: start rwd-embed-7b quantized
[2026-03-14T21:05:38Z] cuda: cuMemAlloc retry -> out of memory
[2026-03-14T21:05:38Z] runtime: fallback error: deserialization error: unexpected EOF
[2026-03-14T21:05:39Z] worker: container crashed (exit code 139)
```
Sam: Also seeing repeated "compile timeout" during kernel JIT for aten attention kernels on some nodes. Logs show compile_time_ms > 120000 for many ops.
Alex: What’s the spread? Is it a single instance type or across different GPU types?
Morgan: Appears concentrated on p4d-like instances (p4d-24xlarge). A few a100 hosts too but less frequent. Could be new kernel release interacting poorly with certain CUDA driver versions.
Rita: Noted customer impact: error rate is causing degraded responses for several customers in us-west-2. CS says 2 customers opened high-priority tickets (AcmePay + LumaHealth). Ben-CS is on the thread.
Ben-CS: Got the tickets, AcmePay reports failed transactions at ~21:06 UTC. They're requesting a status and ETA. Can we provide mitigation soon?
Alex: Quick mitigation plan: 1) disable model warmup prefetch for rwd-embed-7b on affected pools, 2) scale up fallback pool with quantized v2 (rwd-embed-7b-q4_0) with conservative batch sizes, 3) cordon/reboot the flapping nodes after drain.
Lina: I’m taking the on-call. Assigning to me now. I’ll execute steps and update. :point_down:
OpsBot: @Lina assigned incident-sev2 -> oncall. Handoff complete.
Lina: Doing step 1: toggling warmup_prefetch=false for the us-west-2 route. Patch: ```
PATCH /config/routes/us-west-2
{ "warmup_prefetch": false, "affected_models": ["rwd-embed-7b"] }
```
Lina: Step 1 applied. Observability: dropping warmup load on autoscale group.
Sam: Starting scaled deploy of rwd-embed-7b-q4_0 to fallback pool with constrained concurrency. Command: ```
redwood deploy --model rwd-embed-7b-q4_0 --region us-west-2 --pool fallback --min 6 --max 12 --batching=auto:latency=100ms
```
Sam: Deploy queued. Will warmup with smaller batches to avoid OOM.
Morgan: Node-level note: kernel jits are timing out at compile stage for newer cuops. I’m reverting the nightly kernel cache on a canary host to test.
Alex: If revert helps, we can push a hotfix to kernel cache selection that prefers pre-compiled kernels for p4d types.
Lina: Observability update: error rate falling from 18% -> 7% over the last 3m since warmup_prefetch toggle and deploying fallback. 5xxs from warmup path dropping.
Ben-CS: Sharing that with AcmePay and LumaHealth. They asked for ETA to full recovery. What’s current ETA?
Lina: Short-term mitigation expected within 10–15 minutes as fallback pool finishes warmup. Medium-term: replace flapping nodes and roll kernel cache revert, ETA 2–3 hours for full stabilization. Will update if that changes.
Rita: Impact classification: some live traffic degraded (partial impact) — only requests hitting rwd-embed-7b on us-west-2 affected; non-US customers unaffected.
Sam: Deployed 8 fallback replicas; warmup progressing with no OOM on those. Logs show successful deserialization for q4_0 variant.
Alex: Can we add an automatic fallback rule to route to pre-quantized variant when warmup fails x times in y seconds? Might prevent customer-visible errors.
Morgan: Good idea. I can prototype a fallback-policy: ```
if model_warmup_failures(model) > 3 within 120s -> route -> model + "-q4_0" priority=high
```
Lina: For now, manually enabling fallback routing for rwd-embed-7b in us-west-2. Manual toggle done.
